title: CPSC, Briggs & Stratton Announce Recall of Engines Used on Fun Kart Type Go-Karts
summary: Fuel from the engine can spill out, if the fun-kart overturns, posing serious fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 160,0000.

title: CPSC, Motorola Inc. Announce Recall of Digital Cable Set-Top Boxes
summary: Pins in the rear of the box, that connect to the power cord, could break, which could pose an electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 1 million.

title: CPSC, Adams Manufacturing Corp. Announce Recall of Folding Chair
summary: Some of the legs on these chairs were mis-assembled by the installer and a piece of the chair could be bent out of shape. This can allow the chair to collapse during use, causing consumers to suffer injuries from falls. Units: About 2,740.

title: CPSC, Crate & Barrel Announce Recall to Repair Media Carts
summary: The media cart has metal and plastic casters that can break, causing a television or other objects on the cart to fall and injure consumers nearby. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Wooden Clacker and Ride-On Toys
summary: The wooden peg can come off of the Star Clacker toy and pose a choking hazard. The Ride-On Duck's wheel cap can break, allowing the wheel to come off and release small parts, also presenting a choking hazard to young children. The Star Clacker wooden toys, also do not comply with the Federal Hazardo

title: National Sporting Goods Announce Recall of Speed Skates
summary: The wheel and axle assemble may break off during skating, resulting in injury to the skater. Units: About 3,600.

title: CPSC, Electrolux Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall of Garden Tractors
summary: Under certain operating conditions, the rear wheel hub may crack or wear and spin free on its axle, resulting in a loss of power to the wheel and brake, which poses the risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 22,000.

title: CPSC, Excel Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Mowers
summary: Excessive heat, vibrations and wear causes the fuel line to droop over time and rub against the transmission fan, causing the fuel line to be cut. This poses a fire hazard and a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, MTD Products Inc. Announce Recall of Grass Bags Used On Electric Lawn Mowers
summary: The lawn mowers have a rear-mounted grass bag that does not seal properly to the rear door of the mower, allowing grass and other debris to be thrown out at the top of the bag. This could result in injury to the operator or bystanders. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Greenlee Textron Inc. Announce Recall of Electrical Testing Meters
summary: An incompatible grommet, located in the battery compartment to protect internal wires, can cause the meter to provide inaccurate voltage and current readings. A meter that inaccurately indicates zero voltage or current creates the potential for electric shock or an electrocution hazard from the equi

title: CPSC, LPK International Announce Recall of Barstools
summary: The dowels connecting the barstools' legs to the seat are not properly secured. During use, the barstools can collapse, posing a risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 1,900.

title: CPSC, Answer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles
summary: The spring and adjuster can separate from the suspension fork and strike the rider, causing injuries. Units: About 850.

title: CPSC, S&G Enterprises, Inc. Announce Recall of Statue of Liberty Cigarette Lighters
summary: The lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards. Units: About 9,700.

title: CPSC and Shindaiwa Announce Recall of Hedge Trimmers Sold in California
summary: The catalytic muffler can overheat and damage the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,100.

title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The pressure switch in the braking system leaks fluid. The unexpected loss of fluid can cause the brakes to fail, posing the risk of serious injury or death. Units: About 45,000.

title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The ball joints on the front suspension of these ATVs can fail, resulting in a loss of control. This can cause the ATV to overturn, posing a risk of serious injury or death to riders. Units: About 45,000.

title: CPSC, BCI Burke Announce Recall of Buckle Bridges on Series 2000 Playgrounds
summary: The platform edge, where the bridges are attached, can crack and the bridge could potentially detach from the platform and result in injuries. Units: 46.

title: CPSC, Black & Decker Announce Recall to Repair Cordless Drill/Drivers
summary: The drill's switch can malfunction and overheat, posing the possibility of a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 950,000.

title: CPSC, Black & Decker Announce Recall to Repair Table Saws
summary: The motor housing on the saw may crack, posing a risk of electric shock to consumers. Units: About 6,100.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Announce Recall of RANGER Off-Road Utility Vehicles and Professional Series Utility Task Vehicles ("UTVs")
summary: The problem with the RANGER vehicles and UTVs involves the swing arm, which is part of the rear suspension. title: CPSC, Fluke Corp. Announce Recall of Digital Multimeters
summary: The recalled units can take longer than normal, up to 18 seconds, to display readings of AC voltages above 500 volts. Users can misinterpret the delayed reading to mean that high voltage is not present. If high voltage is present, users could be exposed to a risk of shock, electrocution, and thermal

title: CPSC, Bradford White Corporation, Announce Recall of Gas Water Heater
summary: The water heater may have been fitted with incorrectly made flue gas baffles. These baffles may affect fuel combustion, resulting in excessive carbon monoxide emissions, which can cause serious injuries and death. Units: 1,220.

title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of Bicycles With Defective Stems
summary: The stem can break away from the bicycle, causing a loss of control, falls and serious injury to riders. Units: About 1,300.

title: CPSC, Cavagna North America Inc., Announce Recall of Safety Relief Valves for Large Propane Tanks
summary: The recalled valves can have sharp internal edges that can cut into gasket seals in the valves, causing a propane gas leak. This poses a risk of fire or burn injuries. Units: About 6,100.

title: CPSC, Marin Mountain Bikes Announce Recall of Mountain Bikes
summary: The steer tube on the front of these bicycles can break off from the two main tubes of the frame, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer serious injury. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Proctor-Silex Announce Recall of Steam Iron
summary: The circuit board inside the steam iron can ignite and present a fire hazard. Units: Approximately 970.

title: CPSC, Carrier Guam Announce Recall of Room Air Conditioners
summary: Salty sea spray can cause the electrical capacitor within these units to corrode, posing a possible fire hazard. Units: About 2,100.

title: CPSC, Babyliss Pro Announce Recall of Hairdryers
summary: The hairdryers do not have an immersion protection device on the power cord and could present a serious electrocution hazard, if exposed to water. Units: About 23,000.

title: CPSC, Haro Bicycle Corp. Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The length of the crank arm in the 2003 model fails to allow sufficient space between the rider's foot and the front wheel, when the front wheel is turned backwards. The rider's foot could come in contact with the front wheel, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer serious injur

title: CPSC, Leifheit International USA Announce Recall of Apple Slicer/Corer
summary: The cutting blade can separate from the center-coring ring during use, causing cuts to consumers' hands and fingers. Units: About 31,000.

title: CPSC, Quixtar Inc. Announce Recall of HOP SHING Juice Extractors
summary: The juice extractor's filter and lid can break apart while in use, projecting parts into the air, causing injuries to nearby consumers. Units: 58.

title: CPSC, Todson Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Tire Floor Pumps
summary: The pressure gauge lens can separate from the pump and strike a consumer, causing injury. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Recall Snowmobiles
summary: On all models, the brake pad may separate from the backing plate, which could cause brake failure. The brake pads will be replaced on all of the models.
